attachments.name: 21-2401 Agreement for Architectural Services – Perkins Eastman Architects – McClymonds High School Site Renovation Project – Division of Facilities Planning and Management

history.action: Adopted
history.motion: A motion was made by Vice President Davis, seconded by Director Yee,that this Agreement or Contract be Adopted . The motion carried by the following vote.

items.presenter: Deputy Chief, Facilities Planning and Management
items.text: Approval by the Board of Education of Agreement for Architectural Services by and between the District and Perkins Eastman Architects DPC, Oakland, CA, for the latter to provide architectural services, as described in Articles 5 and 6 of Agreement, incorporated herein by reference as though fully set forth, for the design-build McClymonds High School Site Renovation Project, in the not to-exceed amount of $1,234,302.00, which includes a not-to-exceed amount of $107,936.00 for additional services, a not-to-exceed amount of $47,000.00 for reimbursable expenses, as the selected consultant, with work scheduled to commence on October 28, 2021, and scheduled to last until July 31, 2025.
